info.title: By Hamdi Public Services API
info.description: Public, read-only structured information about services offered by By Hamdi.

get.summary: Get Vibe Coding Help Session details
get.description: Returns current public information about By Hamdi's 1-on-1 Vibe Coding Help Session ($99, 60–90 minutes), including who it's a good fit for, common blockers, the three-step request → review → work-together process, scope, the request form URL, and the canonical service URL. Submitting the request form does not book a session or charge the user.

200.description: Current Vibe Coding Help Session details
